review_description: We chose AllSafe because I did research on the "Enphase" Sytem because the web site for Enphase impressed me with the ability for me to access my solar panels any time day or night to see how much power we are using and how much we are producing, even down to 15 minute intervals if I wish to. The team at AllSafe were very professional and gave us easy to understand terminology. We would HIGHLY recommend them. The price was the same as others but with their customer service and the Enphase System we are very glad we.went the path that we did. Also a.HUGE Thank You to the wonderful support from Solar Quotes, a brilliant team and informative web site :-)
